uniprot.function: Exhibits esterase activity with p-nitrophenyl esters as substrates, whose carbon chains range from C2 to C16 (pNPC2 to pNPC16). It shows maximum activity with p-nitrophenyl butyrate (pNPC4)..; FUNCTION: It may promote survival in host cells via cell wall modulation and altered immune response of host. Expression in M.smegmatis alters its colony morphology, lipid composition and integrity of the cell wall.
